thread:
Maria: hey team — heads up: i'm out starting 2026-03-16 afternoon through 2026-03-22. need someone to take primary for the Sat AM (03/21) shift and ideally a shadow session this week for the new on-call flow. i'm currently primary and leaving ajay as secondary but we have a gap from 06:00-12:00 PST on Saturday unless someone picks up. :wave:

Ajay: can do secondary coverage as planned, but i'm on a call saturday morning until ~09:30 PST. not ideal for primary kick-off. happy to shadow earlier in week tho.

Sophia: i can take primary Sat 06:00-12:00 PST if needed. i've done the inc triage workflow twice but haven't done a full on-call handoff yet. would like a 30m runthrough/review.

Maria: thanks @Sophia — that would be perfect. can we do a shadow/blocker walkthrough Thurs 03/19 10:00-10:30 PST? i'll show paging, incident-bot actions, and common runbook flows.

Tyler: i can join the shadow too for learning. also happy to take a future primary.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: scheduled shift changes must be recorded in the on-call calendar and channel. To claim a shift, post "claim shift <date>".

Sophia: claiming now: claim shift 2026-03-21 primary 06:00-12:00 PST. posted to calendar and updated team rota. :white_check_mark:

Ajay: thanks. Maria — what are the exact runbooks you'd want me to reference if i need to act as fallback between 06:00-09:30?

Maria: primary runbooks: 1) /runbooks/latency-spike.md — steps for warm restart and reroute, 2) /runbooks/model-fallback.md — when to switch to smaller model variant, 3) escalation.md — contact list. Quick TL;DR: check infra dashboard for queue depth > 500, then try restart worker group A (only if error rate > 2%), then kick cache purge for affected model.

Ops QA: adding docs link https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall (auth required) and the post-incident checklist: reproducer, timeline, customer impact, mitigation steps, RCA owner. Sophia, i'll DM the onboarding checklist with quick exercises for shadowing.

Maria: pairing plan for Thurs: 10:00 — meet in #eng-oncall huddle, i'll run through the paging lifecycle:
```
- Trigger -> incident-bot posts -> triage tags (sev, impacted routes)
- If customer-facing: set incident channel + notify SC/CS
- Run basic mitigations (scale, fallback, restart)
- Open incident ticket and assign owner
- Communicate status every 30m until stable
```

Sophia: noted. do we have any runbook snippets i should memorize? like the exact restart commands?

Maria: yes — example restart snippet (only run if worker group shows >80% cpu for 15m):
```bash
# check group status
redwood infra status --group worker-A --json | jq '.metrics.cpu'
# drain and restart one node
redwood infra drain --node <node-id> --group worker-A
redwood infra restart --node <node-id>
```

Tyler: should we also walk through incident-bot undo steps? last time i saw it post an auto-rollout that we had to revert.

Maria: yep — will show the rollout dashboard and how to trigger a safe rollback. also show how to mute noisy alerts for housekeeping.

Ajay: i can be on standby Sat 09:30-12:00 to pick up if anything persists. Sophia, i suggest we do a dry-run on Fri morning with a simulated page (no blast to customers) so you can go through the motions.

Sophia: fri dry-run sounds great. what time?

Maria: how about Fri 03/20 09:00 PST — i'll trigger a simulated incident and walk through the full remediation flow. plan for 30m.

Oncall Bot: Simulated incident scheduled by Maria for 2026-03-20 09:00 PST. Reminder: do not trigger customer notifications during simulation.

Tyler: i'll set a calendar invite for Thurs 10:00 and Fri 09:00, adding Maria, Sophia, Ajay. also including the runbook links.

Sophia: quick question — if i get paged and it's a routing failure, is the correct first step to failover to the secondary region or to scale up? i want to be sure which to pick under pressure.

Maria: good question — short answer: if errors are 5xx and spikes are sudden, failover to secondary region if available (check Smart Routing panel). if latency across regions, scale up locally and check KV cache hit rates. full decision tree is in /runbooks/routing-failover.md.

Ops QA: added a short checklist card to the onboarding doc: "If paged: 1) confirm page, 2) check alerts and dashboard, 3) attempt mitigations in order: cache purge, restart single node, scale-out, failover."

Ajay: all good from me. thanks Maria for prepping the handoff — Sophia welcome aboard the primary — we'll shadow you until you're comfy. :tada:

Sophia: thanks all. i'll join Thurs + Fri and will ping if i have questions. appreciate the pairing.

Maria: thank you team — marking handoff complete in rota. leaving notes in the incident-log channel for ongoing follow-ups. I'll be reachable by email for emergencies but trusting you all. :heart:

Oncall Bot: Handoff recorded: Maria -> Sophia (primary for 2026-03-21 06:00-12:00 PST). Calendar and rota updated.
